name: Judith (Esau's wife)
title: Hittite wife of Esau
summary: Judith was the daughter of the Hittite Beeri and one of Esau's wives. His marriages to Hittite women brought grief to Isaac and Rebekah.

keyEvents.title: Esau's Hittite wife
keyEvents.description: Esau took Judith, the daughter of the Hittite Beeri, as his wife, bringing sorrow to his parents.
